hook.text: Cobalt powers your phone battery. 70% comes from Congo, where some mines use children as young as seven.

buildup.text: Conflict-free mineral sourcing ensures that mining doesn't fund violence or exploit workers.

discovery.text: Smelter audits and chain-of-custody tracking verify minerals are sourced from responsible operations.

twist.text: Artisanal mines supply 20% of Congo's cobalt. Cutting them off hurts the communities they support.

climax.text: Programs like the Responsible Minerals Initiative audit smelters across 60+ countries.

punchline.text: Clean minerals require dirty supply chains to be transformed.

quiz.question: What percentage of cobalt comes from Congo?
